about: Interstate natural gas pipeline projects that cross Georgia. These are approved by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, not the Georgia Public Service Commission. Counties are those the federal notice names. Read by hand from the sources below; check them before quoting.

sse4_feis.label: FERC notice of the final environmental impact statement for the South System Expansion 4 project (dockets CP25-514-000 and CP25-517-000), dated June 26, 2026, Federal Register July 1, 2026

pgj.label: Pipeline & Gas Journal, FERC approves the Kinder Morgan expansion, Aug. 7, 2026

ferc_list.label: FERC, approved major pipeline projects, 2015 to present

projects.name: South System Expansion 4
projects.owner: Southern Natural Gas and Elba Express
projects.size: 22 pipeline loops totaling about 291 miles in Mississippi, Alabama and Georgia, plus compressor and meter station work
projects.status: Approved by FERC July 31, 2026, per Pipeline & Gas Journal. The federal notice names these counties for the project's facilities as a whole, not loop by loop
projects.check_note: The federal notice and Pipeline & Gas Journal both describe it.
